exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: What sorts of food do you like eating most? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Who normally does the cooking in your home? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you watch cookery programmes on TV? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: In general, do you prefer eating out or eating at home? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a house/apartment that someone you know lives in. You should say: - whose house/apartment this is - where the house/apartment is - what it looks like inside - and explain what you like or dislike about this person's house/apartment.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of home are most popular in your country? Why is this?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: What do you think are the advantages of living in a house rather than an apartment?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think that everyone would like to live in a larger home? Why is that?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: How easy is it to find a place to live in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you think it's better to rent or to buy a place to live in? Why?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that there is a right age for young adults to stop living with their parents? Why is that?
